name: replay-picker-capture
goal: Show open replay speed and scene options in component captures

evidence: Replay Controls uses native speed and scene selectors. Open controls must show their option lists in recorded component images.
component-catalog-previews tests closed selections only; add open selector states, frame their popup and assert changed pixels outside the control.
At 2f0485f38c both open selectors had zero changed pixels outside the control on harbor-mbp-2.
At e62ffee430 Replay Controls enables supported in-page pickers and declares callback errors.
The same desktop selector tests passed at e62ffee430 on harbor-mbp-2.
